protocol.criterion: Minimize maximum complete modeled cost; tie break by fewer predicates, then lexical names and policy. Enter only for strictly positive modeled surplus and sufficient opening cash.
protocol.dispatch: Prepay four units per reserved source, including a source that proves unavailable. Surplus output is permitted and counted as cost.
protocol.fallback: A supplied independent route can deliver the whole declared demand, at fallback_unit_cost per delivered unit, in every modeled state.
protocol.funding: The maximum branch cost must be prefunded; the stated quote arrives only after accepted delivery. No advance, debt, tax, unmodeled support or real trade is simulated.
protocol.matrix_grid: All 512 binary 3-state/3-action admissibility relations, including empty state action sets; all five state partitions.
protocol.observations: A chosen subset of truthful source-status predicates is paid and observed before dispatch. This is stipulated access, not a new measured sensor.
protocol.state_semantics: Exactly one of three sources is unavailable; each other source supplies one unit.
protocol.status: Authored exact-model analysis examined during design, not fresh empirical confirmation or autonomous discovery.
